First, we factor out the constants and get

$$
\begin{aligned}3a\cdot (2b\times (-c)) & =8 \\ 3\cdot 2\cdot (-1)\cdot [a\cdot (b\times c)] & =8 \\ a\cdot (b\times c) & =-\frac{4}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we swap $a$ and $b$ to get

$$
\begin{aligned}b\cdot (a\times c) & =\frac{4}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
